title: Systematic Evaluation of TabPFN-TS for Zero-Shot Probabilistic Heat Load Forecasting in District Heating Networks
description: Software and reproducibility package supporting the systematic evaluation of TabPFN-TS for probabilistic heat load forecasting in district heating networks. The repository contains the shareable TabPFN-TS, Chronos-2, AutoGluon, and Multi-Resolution Residual-Correction Forecaster experiment pipelines, shared utilities, tests, and public Flensburg validation inputs. Unpublished Munich inputs, generated model outputs, plotting scripts, and paper-writing files are not included, so Munich-specific results require separately supplied, properly licensed data. Original project code is licensed under the MIT License. Included datasets and third-party materials retain their original licenses, as documented in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and the accompanying metadata files.
